page.overview:
Who is Gyutaro?

Over a century ago during the Edo period, Gyutaro was a human who worked as a debt collector in the Rashomon Riverbank of Yoshiwara, the lowest class in the Entertainment District, before he and Daki were turned into demons personally by Doma, who was Upper Rank Six at the time.

Gyutaro was a tall man of pale gray complexion speckled with black blotches. His anatomy was quite strange in that his upper torso, arms, and legs were all defined with musculature, whereas his waist was incredibly skinny to the point of looking skeletal, with his pelvis jutting out at an unnatural angle. His spine was prominently visible through his back, and he was usually shown being hunched over. Gyutaro possessed thin eyes that were slanted drastically downwards at the sides, giving him a permanently haggard gaze. His miotic irises were green with a dark orange center, and his sclera was a bright yellow-orange with visible veins. The kanji for |Jogen}} is carved across his right eye, and the daiji for |Roku}} carved on his left. During his fight with the Demon Slayers, he lends his left eye to Daki and spends the rest of his battle with said eye shut, giving him a permanent wink.

He had unruly black hair that transitioned to a brighter lime green around the crown of his head, worn messily in uneven bangs and several locks, along a messy tied top head of his hair. His body and limbs had noticeable ink-like markings in the form of black spots on his body and a flowing water-like pattern on his face. His fingernails and toenails were black. He also had a full set of sharp, interlocking teeth. Gyutaro was described to look very ugly.

Gyutaro wore little, only sporting a pair of baggy gray-blue pants and seven pieces of pattern dark red and black cloth to decorate his body, one large one around his neck and three smaller ones around each arm; two pair for each biceps, and two on both his wrists. After Tengen's failed attempt to decapitate Gyutaro by holding on to the tip of his dual Nichirin cleavers, the cloth around his neck was cut and he spent the remainder of his fight bare-necked, implying that Gyutaro was one of the few demons who wore clothing not made from their flesh.
